title: Circuit breaker in delivery worker prevents thundering herd
description: src/delivery.rs:37,147-153,233-257. The delivery worker uses a fieldwork CircuitBreaker to track failing domains. Deliveries to domains with open circuit breakers are skipped entirely (line 149), preventing retry storms against down servers. Success resets the breaker; client errors get one retry then mark dead; server errors use backoff. 410 Gone correctly does not trigger the circuit breaker (it's resource-specific, not domain-wide). This is production-quality delivery behavior.
